locations.title: Free Ray Gun and Death Machine Easter Egg
locations.description:
**Steps:**

- First, dig up the [Dig Spots](https://mapgenie.io/call-of-duty-vanguard/maps/zombies-terra-maledicta?search=dig_spot%20%26%26%20category%3A28626) around the map until Lost Tome Pages drop.
- Continue digging until four lost tome pages have been acquired.
- While digging, you'll also come across a Ray Gun that comes out of the ground with zombies spawning nearby. 
  - The Ray Gun will move to a [Sealed Room](#loc=1067352), which will be opened at the end of the Easter Egg.
- Once all four are acquired and the Ray Gun has been moved from the dig spot, head to the Sealed Room.
- Interact with the door four times to place the pages onto the door.
  - Each page needs to be placed in a specific order. The order is random for each game, so the solution requires trial and error.
- Once all four are placed, the room will open, revealing the Ray Gun and a Death Machine.

locations.title: Bonus Points Easter Egg
locations.description:
**Steps:**

- First, dig up the [Dig Spots](https://mapgenie.io/call-of-duty-vanguard/maps/zombies-terra-maledicta?search=dig_spot%20%26%26%20category%3A28626) around the map until a red orb spawns.
- Chase and shoot the red orb in the sky until it drops to the ground.
- Interact with the red orb to spawn ten Bonus Points power-ups.
  - This can be done multiple times in one game.

locations.title: Free Sacrificial Heart Easter Egg
locations.description:
**Steps:**

- First, dig up the [Dig Spots](https://mapgenie.io/call-of-duty-vanguard/maps/zombies-terra-maledicta?search=dig_spot%20%26%26%20category%3A28626) around the map until a blue orb spawns and corrupts you.
  - While corrupted, your health will be cut in half.
- Find a red rune scattered around the map and bury the heart inside it.
- Once buried, you will receive a free sacrificial heart.

locations.title: Random Loot Easter Egg
locations.description:
**Steps:**

- First, dig up the [Dig Spots](https://mapgenie.io/call-of-duty-vanguard/maps/zombies-terra-maledicta?search=dig_spot%20%26%26%20category%3A28626) around the map until an antenna drops.
- Place the antenna on the [Antenna Radio](#loc=1067363) against the wall on Merchant Road.
- Around the map, three other antennas will now need to be rotated by interacting with the radio:
  - [Antenna Radio](#loc=1067369)
  - [Antenna Radio](#loc=1067368)
  - [Antenna Radio](#loc=1067366)
- After rotating the last antenna, a large amount of Sturmkriegers will spawn.
- Once defeating the last one, it will drop a chest with a variety of loot.

locations.title: Decimator Shield Easter Egg
locations.description:
**Steps:**

- First, complete a portal objective at one of the [Challenge Portals,](https://mapgenie.io/call-of-duty-vanguard/maps/zombies-terra-maledicta?search=challenge_portal%20%26%26%20category%3A28646)
- Once you've unlocked the Merchant Road area to the east of the Temple, head close to the [Decimator Shield](#loc=1067377) trapped on a crystal to get a dialog sequence.
- Next, complete another portal objective.
- Then, head to the Tents area and interact with the [Ancient Corrupt Rune](#loc=1067238) to spawn a challenge portal.
- Once completed, head back to the Decimator Shield to get another dialog sequence.
- Next, head around the map and destroy four yellow crystals:
  - [Yellow Crystal](#loc=1067399)
  - [Yellow Crystal](#loc=1067397)
  - [Yellow Crystal](#loc=1067395)
  - [Yellow Crystal](#loc=1067392)
- Once all four are destroyed, head to the second [Ancient Corrupt Rune](#loc=1067403) inside the Bazaar and interact with it.
- Head through the new portal that spawns to fight a boss.
- Once defeated, the Decimator Shield will break free and will be useable.
  - The Decimator Shield acts as a weapon, taking up a weapon slot.

locations.title: Terra Maledicta Main Easter Egg
locations.description:
**Steps:**

- First, acquire the Decimator Shield by completing the [Decimator Shield Easter Egg](#loc=1067380).
- Once acquired, head to the final [Ancient Corrupt Rune](#loc=1067417) and interact with it to spawn the final portal.
- Head inside and use the alternative fire on the Decimator Shield to break the connections holding the Tome Page.
- Once done, the red orb will fall. Interact with it to receive the Tome Page and a variety of loot once back in the desert.
